entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 4 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Breathe temporal fire over the battlefield, burning away you and your foes' fates, removing your Convergence, and burning you for 10% of your health per target hit. The most intense flames affect your primary target, searing their timeline and increasing the DoT damage they take by 150% for 7 seconds. Their destiny remains alight for the duration, burning them for a powerful DoT. Cannot be avoided, but cannot crit.
notes: Applies Rend to 4 enemies, dealing a DoT that lasts 10 seconds and stacks to 5.
Applies Destiny Alight to the primary target, a DoT that ticks once per second and lasts 7 seconds.
If Convergence is NOT active, applies Discordance to the caster, increasing DoT done by 25%. This stacks to 10 and lasts 9 seconds.
If Convergence is present on caster, Convergence is consumed and Searing Timeline is applied to the primary target, increasing the amount of DoT damage they take by 150% for 7 seconds.
